changes: Discard each failed live-ISO SSH discovery key; promote only after unique-client-key authentication and installed-root checks.
Enforce StrictHostKeyChecking=yes and the promoted key for independent boot.
Treat subprocess.TimeoutExpired as a transient failed SSH probe within the outer wait bound.
Accept only /dev/vda2 with an optional Btrfs subvolume suffix as installed-root proof; reject prefix collisions.
